b: It’s time for a slow, gentle December. I’m thrilled to announce that this daily, holiday e-mail gift program is back! Learn more about 31 Days of Gifts and how to share it with friends and family. We can’t wait to share these gifts with you!

Every day throughout December, you’ll receive a gift in your inbox. At the end of each daily email, you’ll find links to the gifts that came before. If you join after we get started, miss a gift, or want to revisit one of your favorite gifts (or all of them), this list makes it easy to go back. By the end of December you’ll have all 31 Days of Gifts in one easy to access email.

It’s time for 31 Days of Gifts You So Deserve! Sharing this holiday offering has been my cue to kick off the holiday season for the last 14 years. Creating this with my daughter Bailey makes this even more special.
All of the details about this holiday program are below but if you are ready, sign up here.

31 Days of Gifts You So Deserve is like an advent calendar in your inbox. You’ll receive meaningful, magical gifts throughout the month of December. These gifts will encourage you to embrace the holidays with joy and intention, and to take time for yourself. They will also help you move into the new year with an open heart.

For many in the Be More with Less community (myself included), 31 Days of Gifts You So Deserve has become a holiday tradition. I love how you embrace the daily gifts and invite friends, family, and co-workers.
If you haven’t participated before, you might be interested in hearing what participants have to say about the program.

I just wanted you to know that this was one of my HIGHLIGHTS of December! – Julie

I so appreciated the 31 days of gifts in my inbox during the hectic beautiful and magical month of December. I listened to your stories, danced and sang to your playlists, tried a recipe or two and spent time just thinking about what you wrote each day. – Loretta
Why Join 31 Days (plus a free sampling of gifts)

This program is a reminder that the best things don’t come from or in perfectly wrapped packages. If we want to experience the very best gifts, we have to give ourselves time to pay attention to them and permission to enjoy them.

Each year, more and more people send 31 Days of Gifts to friends, family, and co-workers. We’ve had book clubs, corporate offices, community groups, churches and families spanning the globe participate together. That is just one of the many reasons this program is so dear to my heart. It’s so affordable, fun to connect around and easy to enjoy.
Gifts of holidays past have included …
recipes for sweet and savory treats
As you may have guessed, these gifts are not physical objects because we all know the best things aren’t things. Click here to sample a couple of gifts to see what I mean.

This year will include favorites from the last few years + new gifts to help you create new holiday memories and be present for holiday magic. You deserve the gift of discovering what’s most meaningful to you over the holidays. You deserve a few quiet moments to yourself. You deserve to give yourself permission to make room for the best things … instead of trying to make room for all the things.

For the last 14 years, this program has been offered for $3.10 (only ten cents a day), but it is worth so much more. As more people participate, we invest more time and money to make these gifts available and meaningful. If you’ve participated before, you understand the value of the program, but I also know that for some, $3.10 is barely in the holiday budget.
Each year I consider raising the price, but instead, I’ll continue to leave it up to you. Please pay what you want so everyone can continue to enjoy the gifts they so deserve with a small investment.
How to join and send gifts …
click the image below or use this link.
complete the form with your name, email and whether you’d like to gift 31 days to friends or family
if you select “yes” for gifting, you’ll be prompted to add how many gift recipients and their email addresses. We will add them to the 31 Days mailing list.
edit the price to what you want to pay (minimum $3.10 per name, including yourself).
Complete the purchase by choosing your payment method.
After you complete your purchase, you can download the welcome letter and then check your inbox for an email with more information about receiving your gifts.

Q: When do I receive my first gift? December 1st or the day after you sign up in December. If you join later in December, you’ll find all prior gifts listed in your first email. You won’t miss a thing!

Q: How will my gift recipients know I sent them this as a gift?
Once you purchase, you’ll receive a gift letter to share with them. It’s really important to let them know to expect emails from [email protected] or they may think its junk mail and unsubscribe.

Q: Is there a deadline to join?
We recommend joining as soon as possible so you can start receiving gifts on December 1st, but you can register anytime thru December and still have access to all 31 gifts.

Q: How do I access gifts I missed?
All the gifts are listed in each email with links so you can go back to gifts you missed or ones you want to revisit.

Q: Can I join from anywhere?
Yes! If you have an email address, we’ll send you gifts.

Q: Do I need special login information or a password?
No. Everything will be delivered via email.

Q. How do I make sure my gift recipients get their email?
Let them know what to expect in advance. We’ll be sending you a gift message PDF that you can forward and we highly recommend you have a conversation to tell them it’s coming. Give them the chance to be excited about looking for their gifts each day.
Enjoy these daily doses of delight throughout December. Gentle reminders and joyful recommendations will guide you through the month with wonder and simplicity.
This program is something we look forward to every year. We are so excited to share these gifts with you. Thank you so much for participating, gifting, sharing and enjoying these gifts.
